title: Ryan (author of The B Corp Handbook) on Goodreads — 'one of the most important books for the B Corp movement I have ever read'
summary: Ryan, who wrote The B Corp Handbook, posted a Goodreads review in the book's launch week treating Incorruptible as required reading for B Corps. His cautionary case is Allbirds, where certification and benefit-corporation status did not hold against financial gravity.
blockquote: I am the author of "The B Corp Handbook." Incorruptible is one of the most important books for the B Corp movement I have ever read.
